title: Starry Night Homestead
description: A nocturnal rural landscape featuring a glowing wooden farmhouse with lit windows, set in a vast golden field under a dramatic night sky. The Milky Way stretches across a deep blue and purple cosmos filled with bright stars and a luminous full moon, framed by an ornate vintage wooden picture frame.
